author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Autumn brings the perfect season for gathering fresh honey mushrooms from the forest 🍄🌿 In this video, we enjoy a peaceful mushroom harvest, prepare part of the bounty for winter pickling, and cook a warm rustic lunch with freshly gathered mushrooms.

The mushrooms are carefully cleaned and preserved in jars, capturing the rich flavors of autumn for the colder months ahead. The rest are turned into a simple homemade meal, full of earthy aroma and comforting countryside flavor.

This is traditional seasonal village cooking — gathering food from nature, preserving it for winter, and enjoying part of the harvest fresh. A beautiful autumn day filled with forest flavors, homemade food, and simple country traditions. 🍂🫙🔥
title: Autumn Honey Mushroom Harvest | Pickling for Winter & Rustic Lunch 🍄🌿
